caption:
Stock market news | RBI retains SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank as systemically important

On 23 November 2026 the Reserve Bank of India confirmed that State Bank of India, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank remain classified as domestic systemically important banks for 2026.

The banks must meet extra Common Equity Tier 1 buffers - 0.80% for SBI, 0.40% for HDFC and 0.20% for ICICI - strengthening their capital resilience.
